title: Sequential protected updates for quantum Reader rotations

rating_policy.notes: Accumulated fitted rescue remains L0 until untouched-question utility is measured.

hypothesis: Re-linearized shared Reader-rotation updates can accumulate multiple training rescues while retaining all original and previously accepted protected memberships.
mechanism: Identity-start exact Jacobian, fixed candidate order, current-set bounded LP, native all59 strict acceptance; quantum and matched classical heads.

training_budget.data_scope: Frozen59 training cases;135 eligible and183 protected; evaluation100/validation87 unopened
training_budget.epochs_or_steps: At most3 accepted updates and12 candidate attempts per step; no optimizer epochs
training_budget.selection_rule: Candidate order fixed once from initial Reader entry gaps; native all59 strict-increase guard
training_budget.seed_policy: Source rotation seed20261013; deterministic CPU HiGHS and native forward

intervention.target: Fixed Top50-to-Top5 via shared classifier-input feature rotations

statistics.method: Deterministic fitted feasibility; no generalization interval applicable

controls.notes: Both initial zero updates exactly preserve the original Reader Top5 membership.
Same200 parameters, candidate order, step/radius/fraction budget and native guard;3 rescues in5 attempts versus quantum3 in8.
Twenty-one native trials are rejected despite LP proposals, preserving nonlinear failure evidence.

task_utility.notes: No untouched question features or labels accessed.

robustness.notes: One fitted cohort and one source seed.

natural_transfer.notes: No independent or full-data transfer test.

attention_alignment.notes: Three fitted support rescues accumulate without original or accepted loss.

classical_attribution.notes: Matched classical reaches the same rescue count with fewer candidate attempts; no quantum-specific effect.

resource_audit.notes: 10 data qubits and200 shared parameters; no state-preparation/readout advantage certified.

trace_observability.selection_rule: First2 complete outputs at every step; all59 scores/Jacobians/constraints/native trials
trace_observability.notes: All378 arrays hashed and all27 native all59 trials independently replayed.

next_upgrade.action: Freeze an unseen question cohort before fitting, fit on training59 only, and evaluate direct/useful Top5 membership target-blind.
next_upgrade.success_gate: Positive untouched effect with zero protected regression; quantum-specific advancement also requires matched-classical separation.
next_upgrade.kill_criteria: No untouched benefit or any protected regression; do not retune on exposed questions.
next_upgrade.estimated_cost: Separate bounded cache experiment; no model or dataset download if features and labels are already qualified.

limitations: Training-label-conditioned parameter search; no held-out utility
Matched classical equals the quantum rescue count and needs fewer candidate attempts
A three-step fixed candidate/radius budget cannot establish global capacity
No generation, finite-shot or quantum-resource advantage evidence

records.role: Independently replayed diagnostic and artifact receipts
